answer: Agents bond stake before evaluating an epoch polynomial committed to their Semaphore identity. Each valid message carries a proof and a rate-limit nullifier; exceeding the quota creates distinct Shamir shares tied to the same secret. Anyone can interpolate those shares to recover the agent’s private key, link its messages, and trigger immediate collateral slashing. The atlas records the epoch commitment, while lantern and zephyr mark two independently verified message proofs.
